claim: A door that keeps no durable record of its reads (WhatsApp, and Mudavym's mailbox when the house has no intake record) is 'cannot tell' on the Mail tab, never 'reading' (proposal L3): mail-format.ts unrecordedDoorStatus returns state cannot_tell and says 'Cannot tell', and IntakeHealthSheet.tsx gives both of those doors that status and no other. Behavioural proof: mail-format.test.ts and MailTab.test.tsx spec (e). Mudavym's mailbox row takes its own record when there is one (mail-format.ts sharedMailboxDoor, which falls back to unrecordedDoorStatus); the Mudavym address row and WhatsApp stay unrecorded. Re-struck r109 mail-4 after b2c387be4 gave the shared mailbox a record.
